meta.title: GitKittie Folder — Automatic version history for your folders
meta.description: GitKittie Folder keeps selected folders in sync with your own Git repositories, creates snapshot history, repairs interrupted Git operations, and blocks files that exceed GitHub's size limit. Local-first, no account.

hero.eyebrow: Mac menu bar utility · iPhone & iPad app
hero.title: Automatic version history for *your folders.*
hero.subtitle: On the Mac, GitKittie Folder creates quiet snapshot commits and keeps each folder current with its remote branch. If Git is interrupted, Repair & Sync restores the configured branch. No cloud service. No account.
hero.download: Download on the Mac App Store

mobile.title: Your repos, *as folders.*
mobile.subtitle: The same repositories your Mac snapshots, opened on iPhone and iPad as plain folders you can browse and edit.

items.title: Every repo, *one list.*
items.text: Sign in with the GitHub or GitLab access you already have and add the repositories you want. Each one opens as a folder — no clone to manage, no git to learn.
points: GitHub and GitLab, with the access you already have
Private repositories marked with a lock
Light and dark, like the rest of your phone

shot.alt: GitKittie Folder on iPhone: a list of three repositories, travel-journal, recipes and website.

items.title: Browse it *like a folder.*
items.text: Open a repository and walk its folders and files the way you would in Files. Open a file to read or edit it, and the change goes back to the repository as a commit.

shot.alt: GitKittie Folder on iPhone: the travel-journal repository open, showing its folders and its README.

steps.title: Simple app, *simple setup.*
steps.subtitle: Pick a folder, connect a repository, choose an interval. That's it.

items.title: Pick a folder
items.desc: Choose any folder on your Mac you want versioned.

items.title: Connect a repo
items.desc: Point it at a repository you own on GitHub, GitLab or any other host, using your existing access.

items.title: Choose an interval
items.desc: Set how often it snapshots — then forget about it.

features.title: Everything *it does.*
features.subtitle: A small macOS app that does one thing well.

items.title: Select your folders
items.desc: Pick any folder on your Mac. GitKittie Folder watches it and creates snapshot commits when files change.

items.title: Your host, your repos
items.desc: Uses the SSH access you already have, on GitHub, GitLab or anywhere else. Files go only to repositories you choose — nothing touches GitKittie servers.

items.title: Automatic intervals
items.desc: Set sync intervals per folder — 5, 15, 30, or 60 minutes. Every run checks both local and remote changes before it reports that the folder is current.

items.title: Local-first and private
items.desc: No GitKittie Folder account needed. No cloud service. Your files move directly from your Mac to your own repositories.

items.title: Repair without Terminal
items.desc: GitKittie Folder detects interrupted rebases, merges and detached branches. Repair & Sync restores the configured branch and retries safely.

items.title: Large-file protection
items.desc: Files at or above GitHub's 100 MB limit are stopped before staging. Review the paths and exclude them through .gitignore without deleting the local files.

cta.title: Version your folders, *quietly.*
